text:
nina (Finance): GCP Marketplace partner CloudLane flagged a proration issue on Apr invoices — they were charged full-month seats even though migration happened mid-month. Disputed amount: $8,412.

billing-bot: Dispute logged: DSP-2026-04-212 | partner: CloudLane (CL-300) | amount: 8412.00 | invoice: INV-GCP-2026-04-342

raj (Marketplaces): Pulling the marketplace usage. Looks like their seat change occurred 2026-04-14 but our proration rule used billing_cycle_day = 1 for that listing so no prorate applied.

kevin (Sales Ops): They signed a one-time seat reduction on 4/13 per contract amendment. Sales notified Marketplaces but maybe the listing update went live after the invoice run.

tia (Billing): Can we do an off-cycle credit? Prefer to avoid revenue reversal for closed month if possible. Proposal: issue partner credit for prorated difference and flag invoice for AR adjustment.

nina (Finance): We need numbers. If they reduced 30 seats from 200 to 170 on 4/13, prorated days = 17/30 -> credit = 30 * seat_price * (17/30). Seat price is $9/day? that's not right. Please calculate exact.

raj (Marketplaces): From usage: seat_unit_price = 10.00 USD/month. Using pro-rata by days (30-day month), days remaining = 17 -> credit = 30 seats * 10.00 * 17/30 = $170.00 * 17 = $2,890. Hmm that doesn't match dispute. Need to include premium addon fee ($20 per seat) applied too. Recompute: base credit $2,890 + addon credit (30 * 20 * 17/30 = $5,780) -> total $8,670. Slight diff vs partner $8,412 (likely rounding/tax).

tia (Billing): OK propose issuing CN-2026-04-1176 for $8,670 and then reconcile tax variance of -$258 with partner if they provide exact calc. Tag JE: GL 4001/1200 and tax variance 5305.

kevin (Sales Ops): CloudLane prefers exact match. I'll ask them to send their calc. If they accept our CN, apply to next invoice.

nina (Finance): Approved provisional CN for $8,670. Hold payment for INV-GCP-2026-04-342 until reconciliation. Billing-bot, block payment?

billing-bot: Payment hold applied to INV-GCP-2026-04-342. Credit note CN-2026-04-1176 created (provisional). Ticket BILL-4854 opened.

raj (Marketplaces): I'll add a post-mortem to ensure listing updates that occur within invoice window trigger a proration flag and a webhook to Sales Ops.

nina (Finance): Thanks. Kevin, please keep us posted when CloudLane responds so we can finalize the JE and close the ticket.
